style: Flat 2D character concept art for a calm, friendly health app. Style rules: flat filled shapes with no outlines and no line art; two-tone cel shading only with light from the upper left: every body part has its base color plus one slightly darker flat shade on its right side, and one small flat highlight at the upper left; no gradients, no texture, no 3D rendering. Palette: body warm apricot yellow (#FFC56E), belly and inner surfaces light cream (#FFEBC4), round blush cheeks coral (#F48C73), small simple eyes and mouth very dark teal-black (#1D3332) with one tiny white highlight dot in each eye; small accent areas may use lagoon turquoise (#3FB7D0), leaf green (#5FA44A) or sand (#F3D9A4). Soft, rounded, friendly forms; no teeth, no claws, no sharp spikes. Playful in the details, but calm, graceful and grown-up overall, not babyish and not a plush toy.
framing: One single creature, full body, centered with generous margin, three-quarter front view, on a plain flat pale mint background (#DDF0EE), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no frame.

A.name: Dünenläufer
constants: cremefarbene Blesse von der Nase über die Stirn
A.constants_en: wide rounded leaf-shaped ears that hang slightly sideways, and a cream blaze running from the nose up over the forehead

forms.hatchling: a newborn, ground-hugging four-legged creature: a small round body lying low on its belly, oversized head, four short stubby legs splayed to the sides, soft round paws without claws, a tiny nub tail
forms.l13: a young, sturdy four-legged creature standing firmly on four short strong legs, body now longer and lower like a young badger or capybara, head in proportion to the body, a short fluffy tail held up, trotting forward
forms.l26: an adult, powerful, low-slung four-legged creature striding forward with a broad deep chest and thick legs, a soft mossy mane in leaf green over neck and shoulders, a longer bushy tail swept back
forms.l43: a majestic, very large elder four-legged creature, broad and heavy like a gentle bison crossed with a tortoise, a soft rounded shell plate in sand color covers its back and carries a tiny moss garden with two round shrubs, head held calm and proud

changes.l13: make the head much smaller in relation to the body; the body becomes long and low like a young badger; it now stands and trots on four clearly visible sturdy legs; a short fluffy tail points up
changes.l26: make it a powerful adult: a much bigger, longer body with a broad deep chest, thick strong legs in a confident striding pose, a soft leaf-green mossy mane now covers the neck and shoulders, and a long bushy tail sweeps back
changes.l43: the whole silhouette changes into a wide low dome like a gentle giant tortoise crossed with a bison: the body becomes much wider than tall, the four legs become short thick pillars, the head is carried low in front, and a big rounded sand-colored shell dome covers the whole back, carrying a tiny moss garden with two round shrubs; the mossy mane becomes a soft collar

B.name: Lagunenling
constants: je drei gefiederte Kiemenwedel in Koralle am Kopf
durchgehender cremefarbener Bauchstreifen vom Kinn bis zur Schwanzspitze
B.constants_en: three feathery coral gill fronds on each side of the head like an axolotl, and one continuous cream belly stripe running from the chin to the tip of the tail

forms.hatchling: a newborn tadpole-like lagoon creature: a big round head, a short wiggly tail with a soft tail fin, no legs at all, floating in the air as if swimming
forms.l13: a young slender lagoon creature like a mix of otter and axolotl: a long flexible body, four small paddle flippers, rearing up on its tail in a playful S-curve
forms.l26: an adult long sinuous lagoon creature, the body twice as long, the flippers have become flowing fin-wings, a soft frilly turquoise fin crest runs along the whole back, the body coils in a loose spiral
forms.l43: a majestic, very long and graceful lagoon dragon without teeth, the body forming one big elegant S-curve floating in the air, long flowing turquoise fin ribbons, the gill fronds have grown into a soft crown

changes.l13: the head becomes much smaller in relation to the body; the body grows three times longer and slender like an otter, with a clear neck; four small paddle flippers grow out; it rears up on its tail in a playful S-curve
changes.l26: the body becomes twice as long and sinuous, the flippers become long flowing fin-wings, a frilly turquoise fin crest grows along the entire back, and the body coils into a loose spiral
changes.l43: the whole silhouette changes into a majestic, very long lagoon dragon without teeth flying sideways: the body stretches horizontally across the whole image in one big wave-like S-curve, the head becomes smaller in relation to the long body, the fin-wings become two pairs of wide flowing turquoise fins, the turquoise crest becomes long trailing ribbons, and the gill fronds have grown into a soft crown

C.name: Wolkenschweber
constants: sehr weit auseinanderstehende Augen in einem breiten, flachen Gesicht
C.constants_en: very wide-set eyes in a broad flat face, and wing-like side fins

forms.hatchling: a newborn floating creature shaped like a wide flat cushion, about twice as wide as tall, hovering in the air; very wide-set eyes near the outer edges of its broad face; two small wing-like side fins; a tiny tail; no legs
forms.l13: a young broad and flat floating creature shaped like a soft manta ray, wide spread wing-fins, a short tail, gliding calmly
forms.l26: an adult very broad floating creature, the wing-fins have become wide drapes with soft scalloped edges, a small mound of leaf-green grass with one tiny round tree grows on its back, short soft tendrils dangle underneath
forms.l43: a huge majestic floating island creature like a gentle sky whale: a very wide body carrying a whole little island landscape on its back with grass, two round trees and a tiny waterfall, long trailing soft roots underneath, enormous wing-fins

changes.l13: the round puff flattens and widens into a soft manta-ray shape at least twice as wide as tall, with wide spread wing-fins and a short tail, gliding calmly; the face sits at the front edge of the wide flat body
changes.l26: it becomes very broad: the wing-fins turn into wide drapes with scalloped edges, a small mound of green grass with one tiny round tree grows on its back, and short soft tendrils dangle underneath
changes.l43: it becomes a huge floating island creature like a gentle sky whale: a very wide body carrying a little island landscape with grass, two round trees and a tiny waterfall on its back, long soft roots trailing underneath, enormous wing-fins

evolve: <image1> shows a creature at its {from_stage} stage. Draw the same creature grown into its {stage} stage. Body change: {change}. Keep from <image1>: the face with its eyes, small mouth and coral cheeks, {constants}, the apricot and cream colors and the flat two-tone style without outlines. One creature, full body, three-quarter front view, plain flat pale mint background.
